description: Fetches tournament information and match data from navi.gg for NAVI (Natus Vincere) esports tournaments.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_tournament_info: Fetches tournament overview (name, dates, prize pool, location, status); 参数: tournament_slug, limit; 必填: tournament_slug
  - get_matches: Fetches match list with teams, scores, and stages; 参数: tournament_slug, limit; 必填: tournament_slug

tournament_slug.description:
The tournament slug from navi.gg URL (e.g., 'blasttv-austin-major-2025').
Used by both get_tournament_info and get_matches functions.

limit.description:
Maximum number of matches to return (default: 50).
Only used by get_matches function.
